evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds a new functional test (feature_dbcrash_replay.py) providing fast CI coverage for chainstate recovery paths.
rationale: Adds fast, deterministic functional test coverage for block rollback and replay logic in Chainstate::ReplayBlocks that previously only ran in extended CI. According to the author, ReplayBlocks was only exercised by the multi-minute feature_dbcrash.py in EXTENDED_SCRIPTS, allowing regressions to pass regular CI unnoticed; this ~1s test deterministically catches two off-by-one mutants in recovery loops. This directly matches the category priority for covering high-risk code paths not reached by standard CI tests, representing worthwhile but deferrable test coverage.
